title: OpenBao Kubernetes platform
description: OpenBao Kubernetes platform. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. See the profile validation record for tested environments and native alert coverage.

options.query:
| `openbao_metric_samples("kubelet_volume_stats_*")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes" OR metric_name="kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes"
| search persistentvolumeclaim=$pvc|s$
| stats min(eval(if(metric_name="kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes",value,null()))) AS available min(eval(if(metric_name="kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes",value,null()))) AS capacity BY bucket_time cluster kubernetes_namespace persistentvolumeclaim
| where isnotnull(available) AND capacity>0
| eval value=100*available/capacity, series=persistentvolumeclaim ." | ".kubernetes_namespace ." | ".cluster, scrape_profile="external"
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats min(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

| `openbao_metric_samples("up")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="up"
| search job=$collector_job|s$
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY _timeseries
| stats min(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

| `openbao_metric_samples("kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total"
| search pod=$pod|s$ container=$container|s$
| `openbao_metric_rate15m`
| eval value=value*900
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time pod cluster
| eval series=pod ." | ".cluster, scrape_profile="external"
| eval _time=bucket_time
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY cluster scrape_profile series
| stats sum(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

| `openbao_metric_samples("container_cpu_usage_seconds_total")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="container_cpu_usage_seconds_total"
| search pod=$pod|s$ container=$container|s$
| `openbao_metric_rate5m`
| stats sum(value) AS value BY bucket_time pod cluster
| eval _time=bucket_time, series=pod ." | ".cluster
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("container_memory_working_set_bytes")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="container_memory_working_set_bytes"
| search pod=$pod|s$ container=$container|s$
| stats max(value) AS value BY bucket_time pod cluster
| eval _time=bucket_time, series=pod ." | ".cluster
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("kube_node_status_condition")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="kube_node_status_condition"
| search node=$node|s$
| where status="true" AND match(condition,"^(DiskPressure|MemoryPressure|PIDPressure)$")
| stats max(value) AS value BY bucket_time node condition cluster
| eval _time=bucket_time, series=node ." | ".condition ." | ".cluster
| timechart span=15s max(value) BY series limit=20 useother=f cont=f

| `openbao_metric_samples("up")`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ instance=$instance|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ openbao_namespace=$openbao_namespace|s$
| where metric_name="up"
| search job=$openbao_job|s$
| `openbao_metric_fresh`
| stats latest(value) AS value BY _timeseries
| stats min(value) AS value count AS contributing_series
| where contributing_series>0
| fields - contributing_series

`openbao_platform_events`
| search cluster=$cluster|s$ kubernetes_namespace=$kubernetes_namespace|s$ pod=$pod|s$ host=$host|s$
| where event_type="Warning" OR match(reason." ".message,"(?i)(warning|failed|unhealthy|backoff|evict|pressure|probe)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host cluster kubernetes_namespace pod node event_type reason message

viz_audit_pvc_free.description: Requires Kubernetes exporter metrics with cluster and Kubernetes namespace labels. Normalize the exporter namespace into kubernetes_namespace. Container, pod, PVC, node, and job inputs use quoted wildcards. Missing exporter data is unknown. This source is not collected by the Compose fixture.
